 November 3, 2026 Bloomberg News is reporting live election results for all 435 US House seats. Eighteen House races are rated toss ups by the Cook Political Report . Nine states have redrawn their congressional maps ahead of the midterm elections. 
 The first polls close at 6 p.m. US East Coast time on Tuesday, Nov. 3.

Democratic and Republican contracts trade in separate markets, so prices may not add up to 100%. Notional trading volume as of Nov. 2, 12 p.m. US East Coast time: Texas District 15 $4.1 million, Montana District 1 $926k, New York District 17 $922k.

 Sources: Vote counts are from the Associated Press. Race calls are from the Associated Press, Decision Desk HQ, ABC, CBS, CNN, Fox or NBC. Prediction market data are from Kalshi. Additional data from American Automobile Association, Standard & Poor’s, US Department of Energy, University of Michigan, Bankrate, Cook Political Report with Amy Walter, Natural Earth, Redistricting Data Hub, US Department of Transportation and Bloomberg reporting. 
 Note: Estimated vote count percentages are based on Estimated Expected Vote Percentage (EEVP) as calculated by the Associated Press.
